newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 17.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on April 17:
WASHINGTON - The state of Maryland ruled that Pepco and Baltimore Gas & Electric Co. can merge, provided they cut rates by $56 million.
WASHINGTON - Publishing giant Harcourt General Inc said it will offer $740 million in cash to buy National Education Corp.
WASHINGTON - A Justice Department lawyer urged the Supreme Court to close a "loophole" in a federal insider-trading law.

WASHINGTON - Although some travel agencies have shuttered their doors and others have been purchased by larger firms in the past two years, the effects of commission caps on the industry overall have not been as devastating as many predicted.
